svg.text: Python Runtime, Module Boundaries & Inward Dependencies
Start at the upper-left; blue arrows show execution. Dashed links show bootstrap wiring, not request calls.
Not a substitute for domain entities
Import by need, not via a mandatory chain.
Initialization and dependency assembly only; not an HTTP request layer
Wiring targets: services/ · application/ · plugins/ · infrastructure/
Uses domain contracts, not concrete adapters.
Stable business contracts; no FastAPI, DB, or plugin imports.
Implements core ports; assembled by bootstrap.
services/ and application/ are peers, not a call chain.
Worker bypasses API; both entrypoints reuse application use cases.
Static imports point toward the domain core; initialization wiring does not represent request-time invocation.
